knowledge.content: Every query executed against Community OS must explicitly include communityId as a mandatory predicate. Cross-community sharing is strictly opt-in through permitted NeedSignal or Action Network channels.

knowledge.title: Telegram Mini App Initialization Data Verification
knowledge.titleAr: التحقق من بيانات تشغيل تطبيقات تيليجرام المصغرة (InitData)
knowledge.content: Never trust raw query string values from Telegram WebApp initData without computing HMAC-SHA256 with the bot token secret. Check auth_date to reject replays older than 86400 seconds.
